passages.text: [paraphrase, replace before demo] You are lying in a small motorboat, drifting toward your dock. The sky vibrates with stars.

passages.text: [paraphrase, replace before demo] Overhead, the Milky Way is a pale river of light, thousands of stars too faint to see alone but luminous together.

passages.text: [paraphrase, replace before demo] One point of light does not move. Everything else wheels slowly around it through the night.
